segments.name: Radio
segments.description: Operates broadcast radio stations and complementary digital marketing services serving local, regional and national advertisers in mid-sized markets.
segments.evidence: We serve twenty-eight radio markets (reporting units) that aggregate into one operating segment (Radio), which also qualifies as a reportable segment.

revenueModel.text: Local and national advertisers pay for advertising time on the company's radio stations and for complementary digital advertising services.
revenueModel.evidence: Our primary source of revenue continues to be the sale of advertising to local and national businesses seeking to reach consumers in the markets we serve.
